title: Meet TabletopKit for visionOS
description: Build a board game for visionOS from scratch using TabletopKit. We’ll show you how to set up your game, add powerful rendering using RealityKit, and enable multiplayer using spatial Personas in FaceTime with only a few extra lines of code.

        rotation: .degrees(0)),
  .init(position: .init(x: -Double(GameMetrics.tableDimensions.x), y: 0),
        rotation: .degrees(-90)),
  .init(position: .init(x: Double(GameMetrics.tableDimensions.x), y: 0),
        rotation: .degrees(90))
